name: qs-design
description: Business-conditioned, context-isolated product design with structure-first content and native cross-platform verification.

interface.shortDescription: 业务条件化、结构先解释的跨平台产品设计
interface.longDescription: 从模糊业务语言、真实内容、连续性契约与平台能力形成一至三个必要方向；让结构和操作先完成解释，只保留不可替代文字，并以可验证的原生表达交付 iOS、Android、Web、微信和支付宝体验。
defaultPrompt: Use QS Design to compile an authorized task context, model the business, and explore one to three genuinely different directions according to uncertainty before modifying product code.

Make structure, hierarchy, spacing, data and clear actions explain the interface before adding helper copy; keep critical facts visible and reserve tooltips for short optional non-interactive information.
